class: a red already on the base, with no base result at hand, read as the change's and sent to remediation
caught_by: cache records keep each red file's failing test names, where the side ran and which inputs it saw. The base side inherits a named fail only from a whole run's record at the base's key, Step 0d's or a schedule's, that saw every path the tier copies: a red whose failing tests all failed there is carried, other names are newly red against the base, and a file the record marks flaky goes to the rerun. The records of a compared run, and records without names, serve passes only
missed_by: pass-only inheritance with no pass at the base's key: the base was absent or vacuous, every red over it was newly red with basis no-base, and a red the change had not caused blocked the run

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
